info.name: Transpose Block API Token Prices API API

params.name: chain_id
params.description: A keyword (e.g., "ethereum") or CAIP-2 identifier specifying the blockchain to query. Supported values: ethereum, polygon, optimism, scroll, arbitrum, base, avalanche.

params.name: contract_address
params.description: The token contract address to query price for.

items.docs: Access up-to-the-minute pricing details for any token by contract address. Returns current price in USD and ETH.

params.name: chain_id
params.description: A keyword (e.g., "ethereum") or CAIP-2 identifier specifying the blockchain to query. Supported values: ethereum, polygon, optimism, scroll, arbitrum, base, avalanche.

params.name: contract_address
params.description: The token contract address to query price history for.

params.name: timestamp_after
params.description: Start of price history range (ISO-8601 or Unix timestamp).

params.name: timestamp_before
params.description: End of price history range (ISO-8601 or Unix timestamp).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

items.docs: Gain access to a comprehensive token price series. Download data in customizable formats for any token address within a specified time range.

params.name: chain_id
params.description: A keyword (e.g., "ethereum") or CAIP-2 identifier specifying the blockchain to query. Supported values: ethereum, polygon, optimism, scroll, arbitrum, base, avalanche.

params.name: contract_address
params.description: The token contract address to query OHLC data for.

params.name: timestamp_after
params.description: Start of OHLC range (ISO-8601 or Unix timestamp).

params.name: timestamp_before
params.description: End of OHLC range (ISO-8601 or Unix timestamp).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

items.docs: Get OHLC/candlestick data for any token address and time interval. Supports minute-to-month granularity. Also supports LP token valuation across Balancer, Curve Finance, Uniswap, Convex Finance, Yearn, Synthetix, and Aave.
